result.topic_en: Calculations on the differential equations $\frac{ddy}{d\varphi^2}=y-2\cot 2\varphi\,\frac{dy}{d\varphi}$ for $y=\mathfrak{F}\cos\varphi$, $z=\mathfrak{F}\sin\varphi$, deriving first integrals and constants involving $\varpi$ and $\pi$ (lemniscatic constant), in connection with the arithmetic-geometric mean.
